name: Grey and mild
story: A mild, grey day under a low ceiling of stratocumulus, the air soft and damp, the southeasterly freshening through the evening and drizzle setting in after dark. Fly early; tomorrow is the gale.
forecast: Overcast, base 700 m, no rain until evening. Southeast 8 kt, 14 kt by night, drizzle after 21:00. GALE tomorrow: no flying from dawn to 17:30.
